title: Universe X #1 Marvel Comics 2000 Alex Ross Cover Jim Krueger Earth X Sequel
conditionDescription: Bright, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Universe X #1 (2000), Marvel Comics - sequel to Earth X. Painted Alex Ross cover; story by Jim Krueger and Alex Ross, art by Doug Braithwaite. Direct edition, $3.50 cover price.

Back cover: L2 Jeans (Levi Strauss) ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
